statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-87864: with CRLF conversion enabled (CURLOPT_CRLF, or --crlf in the curl tool), an IMAP APPEND upload announces the size of the data before conversion but sends the converted, longer data, so the extra bytes can be read by the server as further IMAP commands in the authenticated session (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87864.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 7.30.0 to 8.21.0 and was fixed in curl 8.22.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/3b547de301342b347fb3c6ea6ae7979070793a66, which refuses such an upload with the error 'Cannot APPEND with CRLF conversion making size unknown'. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 published in the DHI Alpine main repository as of 2026-11-28 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. That full error message is in libcurl.so.4 in libcurl and in the IMAP object of the static libcurl.a in curl-static, on x86_64 and aarch64, in 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1 and in no earlier build, while the older message 'Cannot APPEND with unknown input file size' is in every build. 8.22.0-r0 is the first fixed build. Packages published only in the DHI Alpine security repository, which needs credentials, were not inspected.
